cv_kind_link.name: cv_kind_link
cv_kind_link.value: ("cv"."kind" = 'master' and "cv"."pipeline_item_id" is null) or ("cv"."kind" = 'special' and "cv"."pipeline_item_id" is not null)

opportunity_target.name: opportunity_target
opportunity_target.value:
("opportunity"."type" = 'job' and "opportunity"."job_posting_id" is not null and "opportunity"."event_listing_id" is null)
       or ("opportunity"."type" = 'event' and "opportunity"."event_listing_id" is not null and "opportunity"."job_posting_id" is null)

profile_salary_range.name: profile_salary_range
profile_salary_range.value: "profile"."salary_max" is null or "profile"."salary_min" is null or "profile"."salary_max" >= "profile"."salary_min"

schedule_day_of_week.name: schedule_day_of_week
schedule_day_of_week.value: ("schedule"."frequency" = 'weekly') = ("schedule"."day_of_week" is not null) and ("schedule"."day_of_week" is null or "schedule"."day_of_week" between 1 and 7)

source_apify_actor_required.name: source_apify_actor_required
source_apify_actor_required.value: ("source"."provider" = 'apify' and "source"."apify_actor_id" is not null) or ("source"."provider" <> 'apify' and "source"."apify_actor_id" is null)
